name: python-roman-numerals
title: Roman Numerals
blurb: convert between integers and roman numerals: int_to_roman turns a positive integer into its letter form, roman_to_int reads a roman string back into an integer, and the audit reports any pair that does not round-trip; out-of-range or malformed inputs are named, never converted.
default_description: A conversion walker whose roman string is the standard subtractive form on every small integer, whose integer reading is the value on every well-formed roman string, and whose audit names every pair that fails to round-trip.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: subtractive notation trades one letter for four
